add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../dmusic)

spec2def(dmcompos.dll dmcompos.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(dmcompos registry dmcompos.idl)

# dmcompos.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dmcompos-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dmcompos_shims OBJECT chordmap.c chordmaptrack.c composer.c dmcompos_main.c signposttrack.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmusic/dmobject.c)
target_link_libraries(dmcompos_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dmcompos_shims)
add_dependencies(dmcompos_shims wineheaders)
set(DMCOMPOS_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmcompos/dmcompos_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dmcompos dmcompos-cargo dmcompos.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dmcompos_shims psdk dmcompos_r ${DMCOMPOS_REUSED} uuid_sources)
